official_BIS_description: from 5 Oct 2010 to 3 Apr 2013: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1%
from 4 Apr 2013 to 20 Sep 2016: no policy rate
from 21 Sep 2016 to 20 Mar 2024: the BOJ set the guideline for market operations which specifies a short-term policy interest rate at minus 0.1% and a target level of 10-year JGB yields at around 0%
From 21 Mar 2024 to 31 July: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0 to 0.1 %
From 1 Aug 2024 to 26 Jan 2025: the BOJ encouraged the UOCR to remain at around 0.25%
From 27 Jan 2025 to 21 Dec 2025: the BOJ encourages the UOCR to remain at around 0.50 percent
From 22 Dec 2025 to 16 Jun 2026: the BOJ encourages the UOCR to remain at around 0.75 percent
From 17 Jun 2026 onwards: the BOJ encourages the uncollateralized overnight call rate to remain at around 1.00 percent
From 1 Jan 2000 to 12 June 2019 mid-point of the SNB target range
From 13 June 2019 onwards SNB Policy rate
from 15 Oct 2008 to 17 Sep 2024: official central bank liquidity providing, main refinancing operations, fixed rate
From 18 Sep 2024 onwards: official central bank steering rate is the deposit facility rate, fixed rate
